title: Notes storage and routes (/hub/notes)
what:
src/notes/: <home>/notes (0700), files 0600 via write_atomic_0600.
Names and files:
- a name matches ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$
- new notes get names::birth_name; rename uses names::slug(title) with -2 on a clash
- only regular files directly inside: no symlinks (symlink_metadata), no dotfiles
- the title is the first non-empty line, at most 120 chars, control chars dropped
Caps: 256 KiB per write (413); at most 2000 listed; UTF-8 with no NUL. The sha256 of the file is the etag.
Routes:
- GET /hub/notes -> [{name, title, size, mtime}]
- POST /hub/notes {text?, title?} -> 201 {name}
- GET /hub/notes/<n> -> {name, text, sha, mtime}
- POST /hub/notes/<n> {text, base} -> 200 {sha, mtime} | 409 {sha} | 413
- POST /hub/notes/<n>/rename {title}
- POST /hub/notes/<n>/trash -> 204
- GET /hub/notes/trash; POST /hub/notes/trash/<n>/restore (409 on a name clash); POST /hub/notes/trash/empty {confirm:true}
- POST /hub/notes/<n>/send delegates to mail::send_note (a stub until M2)
Trash: <home>/trash/notes/, by atomic rename. The chat trash only reads *.eid, so the two cannot collide.
Exports notes::create(ctx, title, text) for M2's 'save as note'.
tests:
tests/notes.rs:
- name grammar; a symlink inside is refused; a dotfile is ignored
- 256 KiB + 1 gets 413; NUL gets 400
- a stale base gets 409 with the current sha
- rename clash gets -2; trash and restore; a restore clash gets 409; empty needs confirm and removes only *.md
- files are 0600 and the dir 0700
- 401 without a token
risk: Two tabs editing one note: the sha etag turns that into a visible conflict, never a silent overwrite.
